title: Scaffold package, offline test guard and provenance-labelled fixtures
prompt:

Preserve research files; fixture manifests distinguish recorded facts, partial response envelopes and synthetic data. Never invent current operator, approval, water requirement or open contract claims. Label holders and historical reporting operators accurately, retain date precision and evidence links, and emit contract_status=not_verified. No email sending, publishing or application hosting.

Acceptance always includes making the exact command python -m pytest -q pass from the repository root. Run it after your changes; report its result, files changed, implementation decisions and any unresolved limitations. Do not commit, push, stage changes or amend history: the driver reviews and commits.

M1 is the first implementation milestone; no application code is assumed to exist. Establish the small package and shared contracts that later milestones can extend. Create pyproject.toml with Python >=3.11 and pytest development/test configuration, radar/__init__.py, radar/__main__.py, radar/cli.py, radar/config.py and radar/models.py. Provide python -m radar --help plus fetch/score/report/all help and PLAN.md option names. Commands not implemented yet must fail clearly instead of reporting success. Define simple typed containers for source batches, provenance/coverage, evidence and score/report views as needed; do not build fetching, persistence, scoring or reports now.

Create tests/conftest.py with an autouse guard blocking socket connection and DNS entry points for the whole pytest process, allowing fake transport injection without any live-network exemption. Add tests/test_cli_help.py and tests/test_fixtures.py. Extend .gitignore for out/, pytest caches and SQLite sidecars while retaining existing rules and keeping intentional samples visible.

Create tests/fixtures/manifest.json, recorded/, synthetic/ and replay/. Copy the allowed feature samples from research/samples (MINEDEX sample, water types, tenements, WAMEX, EPBC; useful count/stage files may also be copied) without modifying their bytes. Record source paths, original capture time/URL when known, SHA-256, licence attribution and whether a response was truncated. Do not claim the research has complete schema/licence response bodies; any constructed metadata must be synthetic. Recorded EPBC has YEAR only and a malformed referral URL; WAMEX has an old report and a truncated abstract; tenement samples include pre-1970 dates and historical address fields that production clients must not request.

Define a straightforward replay manifest format documented within the fixture manifest or tests/fixtures/README.md. Include an explicitly selected-records recorded baseline replay referencing unchanged research facts, labelled partial and not statewide; original exceededTransferLimit=true must remain visible. Provide focused synthetic variants for ambiguous matches, deposit named Borefield, negated/historical WAMEX, stale/missing dates, conflicting business keys, multi-holder tenements, failed/truncated pagination, valid/invalid reviewed approval and contractor evidence.
